name: Draconyx
sum: A camptosaur-like ornithopod from the Late Jurassic Lourinhã Formation of Portugal, known from partial remains of an adult.
wsnote: Estimate by Paul in 2010 of 3.5 m and 150 kg.
holotype: Partial remains from Vale de Frades, Lourinhã Formation, found in 1991 by Carlos Anunciação.
material: A left femur (ML 434) from Praia do Caniçal has been referred to the genus.
biology: Histology of the holotype shows it was skeletally mature at 27 to 31 years old.
author: Mateus and Antunes 2001
